service.description: What an editor shows beside a script: the fn: functions, the profiles and their limits.

parameter.name: library
parameter.description: [{name, help}]

parameter.name: limits
parameter.description: {profile name: ScriptProfile.toMap()}

service.description: The runtime kill switch for user scripts on this server (the setting jexl_scripts_enabled=false still wins). Off: every user script run ends DISABLED; .jexl files the application ships still run.
What the script lane is doing on this server.
Parses a script without running it: refuses syntax its profile leaves out and any name but input.

parameter.name: error
parameter.description: {kind, message, line, column} when not ok

service.description: Creates or updates a script after checking it: it must parse under its profile, read only input, and run on its sample input within half its work budget. While the server is busy the trial run is skipped and a note says so. No transaction is held while the trial run runs.

parameter.name: readSpecJson
parameter.description: The read step (org.moqui.jexl.script.ReadSpec); its sources must exist and implement read#ScriptSource.

set.from: ['The server is busy (' + busyReason + '), so the script was saved without a trial run on its sample input.']

service-call.name: store#jexl.script.UserScript
service-call.in-map: [userScriptId:userScriptId, scriptName:scriptName, description:description, scriptProfile:checked.profile, scriptBody:scriptBody, sampleInputJson:sampleInputJson, readSpecJson:readSpecJson ?: null, ownerUserId:ec.user.userId, isActive:isActive]

service.description: Runs a saved script (userScriptId) or the body given, against input, inputJson or else the saved sample. A script that fails or hits a limit is ok=false with the error, not a service error. While the server is busy the script is not run (error kind BUSY).

parameter.name: input
parameter.description: Any JSON-shaped value; copied before the script sees it.

parameter.name: readSpecJson
parameter.description: A read step to run first, as the logged-in user; a saved script's own when not given.

parameter.name: scriptResult
parameter.description: What the script returned (named so, since result is taken in XML actions).

parameter.name: normalizedResult
parameter.description: The result contract: {summary, files, data}, {nothing: true} or {invalid: true, message}.

parameter.name: readCounts
parameter.description: Rows each input of the read handed the script.

parameter.name: error
parameter.description: {kind, message, line, column} when not ok

return.message: Give a userScriptId or a scriptBody.

service.description: A read source for the read step. Called logged in as the script's owner with authorization on. It hands back at most maxRows rows (plain maps) for one input of a read spec, applying the input's fields, where, window, groupBy, measures and orderBy (org.moqui.jexl.script.ReadConditions can do them in memory), or an error {kind: READ_NOT_ALLOWED, READ_ERROR or READ_TOO_LARGE, message}.

parameter.name: input
parameter.description: The input as written in the read spec.

service.description: Registers (or changes) a read source: its name, used as an input's source in a read spec, and a service implementing read#ScriptSource. "entity" is built in and cannot be registered.

return.message: The entity source is built in.

service.description: The built-in entity source (org.moqui.jexl.script.EntitySource): only entities listed in the artifact group JEXL_READABLE, never moqui.*, read as the logged-in owner so the owner's grant and its filters apply.

actions.script: if (ownerUserId && ownerUserId != ec.user.userId) { error = [kind: 'READ_NOT_ALLOWED', message: 'The entity source reads only as the script owner.'] return } Map out = org.moqui.jexl.script.EntitySource.read(ec, input, runDate ?: ec.user.nowTimestamp, timeZone, (maxRows ?: org.moqui.jexl.ScriptProfiles.get('SCRIPT').maxReadRows) as int) rows = out.rows rowCount = out.rowCount error = out.error

service.description: Reads a deployment's input. Called by the scheduler with no user; check what the deployment may read from its own fields (an owner added with extend-entity, say).

parameter.name: input
parameter.description: Any JSON-shaped value; none means nothing runs (NO_INPUT).

parameter.name: message
parameter.description: Recorded when there is no input.

service.description: Delivers what a deployment's script returned (never empty), for one of the deployment's deliveries. An error it adds marks this delivery FAILED; the deployment's other deliveries still run.

parameter.name: delivery
parameter.description: The delivery row, with its parametersJson parsed as parameters.

parameter.name: scriptResult
parameter.description: The result contract: {summary, files, data}.

parameter.name: files
parameter.description: [{name, contentType: 'text/csv', contentBytes}], the result's files rendered.

parameter.name: outcome
parameter.description: OK (the default), TOO_LARGE or FAILED.

parameter.name: message
parameter.description: Recorded as the delivery's message.

service.description: Built-in delivery: emails the summary with the result's files attached as CSV (parameters: toAddresses, ccAddresses, emailTemplateId). Over jexl_email_attachment_bytes in all, it sends without the files and says so (outcome TOO_LARGE).
Built-in delivery: a Moqui notification with the summary and the file names, never the files (parameters: topic, userGroupId or userId).

Creates or updates a deployment after checking its script, cron, time zone and services, and sets its next run date (none while it is switched off). Whoever stores it becomes its owner: the user its runs read as, re-checked at every run. deliveries replaces all of its deliveries; deliveryServiceName alone is one.

parameter.name: deliveries
parameter.description: [{deliveryServiceName, parameters (Map) or parametersJson, isActive}]

if.message: A deployment needs at least one delivery.

service-call.name: store#jexl.script.UserScriptDeployment
service-call.in-map: [scriptDeploymentId:scriptDeploymentId, userScriptId:userScriptId, cronExpression:cronExpression.trim(), timeZone:timeZone, inputServiceName:inputServiceName, ownerUserId:ec.user.userId, isActive:isActive, nextRunDate:nextRunDate]

service.description: Runs one deployment now. By default a preview: the result comes back and nothing is delivered or recorded. deliver=true calls the delivery service and records the outcome on the deployment.

parameter.name: scriptResult
parameter.description: What the script returned (named so, since result is taken in XML actions).

parameter.name: run
parameter.description: {ok, profile, result, units, elapsedMs, logs, error}

return.message: Only its owner can run this deployment by hand; saving it makes you its owner.

service.description: Runs the deployments that are due (org.moqui.jexl.ScriptDeploymentScheduler, every jexl_deployment_check_seconds) and stamps each outcome on it; one failing never stops the others. While the server is busy a due one waits, then expires.

parameter.name: held
parameter.description: Deployments left WAITING or marked EXPIRED because the server was busy.
